title: A d-dimensional permutation of order n is an n-by-n-by
exact_target: Does the number of fixed-dimensional permutation arrays have the asymptotic size predicted by the Linial--Luria upper bound?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3100037 (AMR-030-0037). CC BY 4.0.
Nathan Linial and Zur Luria, An Upper Bound on the Number of High-dimensional Permutations (2012), Definition 1.2, Conjecture 1.3 and Theorem 1.4, pp. 2--4.
